cities.description: Two to five cities. offset is minutes from UTC in steps of 15; code is two or three letters shown on the dial.

value.description: Controlled time in UTC minutes from midnight on the reference day. May leave 0 to 1439 to reach adjacent days.

onValueChange.description: Fires with the destination as soon as the dial is released or stepped, before it comes to rest.

homeId.description: Controlled id of the city the dial reads in. Defaults to the first city.

onHomeChange.description: Called when a city is chosen from the list.

min.description: Earliest time in UTC minutes. The dial stretches past it and springs back.

weekday.description: Weekday of the reference day in UTC, 0 for Sunday.

hourCycle.description: Clock for the readout: 12 reads 9:30 AM, 24 reads 09:30.

workingHours.description: Local working hours in minutes from midnight, drawn as a band on the dial. A city inside the band is at work. Defaults to 9:00 to 18:00.
